_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 26, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And make the tabernacle itself of ten strips of fine twisted linen — blue, purple, and scarlet dye — with figures, the work of a skilled craftsman shall you make them.
translations.2: The length of each strip: twenty-eight cubits; and its width: four cubits — one measure for all the strips.
translations.3: Five strips shall be sewn, one to the other; and five strips sewn, one to the other.
translations.4: And make loops of blue along the edge of the one strip at the joining end; and likewise make along the edge of the second joined strip.
translations.5: Fifty loops shall you make on the one strip, and fifty loops shall you make on the edge of the second joined strip — and the loops shall face one another, one opposite the other.
translations.6: And make fifty clasps of gold; and join the strips one to the other with the clasp — and the tabernacle itself shall become one.
translations.7: And make strips of fine wool as a tent over the tabernacle — eleven strips shall you make them.
translations.8: The length of each strip: thirty cubits; and its width: four cubits — one measure for the eleven strips.
translations.9: And sew the five strips together as one, and the six strips together as one; and fold the sixth strip double, facing the front of the tent.
translations.10: And make fifty loops on the edge of the one strip at the joining end, and fifty loops on the edge of the second joined strip.
translations.11: And make fifty clasps of copper; and insert the clasps into the loops; and join the tent together — and it shall become one.
translations.12: And let the surplus hang down from the strips of the tent — the half of the surplus strip you shall let hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.
translations.13: And a cubit from here and a cubit from here of the surplus in the length of the strips shall be spread down over the sides of the tabernacle, from right and left, to cover it.
translations.14: And make a covering for the tabernacle: hides of rams, tanned; and a covering of hides of tahash above.
translations.15: And make the planks for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
translations.16: The length of each plank: ten cubits; and a cubit and a half its width.
translations.17: And it shall have two tenons like two tongues, one opposite the other — so shall you make for all the planks of the tabernacle.
translations.18: And make the planks of the tabernacle: twenty planks, on the side facing the south wind.
translations.19: And forty bases of silver shall you make beneath the twenty planks — two bases beneath each plank, for its two tenons.
translations.20: And for the second side of the tabernacle, facing the north wind — twenty planks.
translations.21: And their forty bases of silver: two bases beneath each plank.
translations.22: And at the rear of the tabernacle, to the west, you shall make six planks.
translations.23: And two planks shall you make for the corners of the tabernacle, at the two angles.
translations.24: And they shall be even from below, and all together shall they be even from above, with a single ring — so shall it be for both corners alike.
translations.25: And there shall be eight planks, with their bases of silver: sixteen bases — two bases beneath each plank.
translations.26: And make bars of acacia wood — five for the planks of the one side of the tabernacle,
translations.27: and five bars for the planks of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the planks of the side of the tabernacle at the two corners to the west.
translations.28: And the middle bar, within the planks, shall pass through from end to end.
translations.29: And overlay the planks with gold; and make their rings of gold as the place for the bars; and overlay the bars also with gold.
translations.30: And erect the tabernacle according to its form as you were shown on the mountain.
translations.31: And make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet dye and fine twisted linen — the work of a skilled craftsman — he shall make it with figures.
translations.32: And hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, with their hooks of gold, upon four bases of silver.
translations.33: And hang the veil beneath the clasps; and bring there, within the veil, the ark of the testimony — and the veil shall separate for you between the sanctuary and the innermost of the sanctuaries.
translations.34: And place the cover upon the ark of the testimony, in the innermost of the sanctuaries.
translations.35: And place the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite it, on the southern side of the tabernacle; and the table — place it on the northern side.
translations.36: And make a curtain for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet dye and fine twisted linen — the work of an embroiderer.
translations.37: And make for the curtain five pillars of acacia; and overlay them with gold; and their hooks of gold; and cast for them five bases of copper.
